lock_codes_owner_check.name: lock_codes_owner_check
lock_codes_owner_check.value: ("app"."lock_codes"."kind" = 'guest' and "app"."lock_codes"."reservation_id" is not null) or ("app"."lock_codes"."kind" = 'crew' and "app"."lock_codes"."task_id" is not null)

properties_price_limits.name: properties_price_limits
properties_price_limits.value: "app"."properties"."min_price_minor" is null or "app"."properties"."max_price_minor" is null or "app"."properties"."min_price_minor" <= "app"."properties"."max_price_minor"
